nodes.name: Every 6h
nodes.notes: ADR-053 Block 2: freshness dead-man's-switch for the Managed Agents lane. Re-derives the ClickUp global-rules hash and compares it to what each LIVE agent carries (a provenance marker in its system). Runs INDEPENDENTLY of Sync Agent Definitions (v1) so it still fires if the sync job is dead. The headline reliability hazard of ADR-053 decision #3 (static system silently drifting from the CU SSOT) is what this retires.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test/on-demand entry via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs. No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Get Anthropic Key
nodes.notes: Reads anthropic_api_key via public.get_anthropic_key() (migration 034) to call GET /v1/agents/{id}.

nodes.name: Get CU Rules
nodes.notes: Same global-rules doc read as Sync Agent Definitions (v1) — must hash the SAME content the SAME way for the comparison to be valid.

nodes.name: Extract Rules
nodes.notes: Identical extraction to Sync Agent Definitions (v1): page q7wz-44812 .content.

nodes.name: Rules Present?
nodes.notes: False -> we cannot verify freshness because the SSOT is unreadable: that is itself a degradation -> CRITICAL.

nodes.name: Alert CU Unreadable
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1): cannot confirm whether agents are stale because the global-rules doc could not be read.

value.message: Nie można zweryfikować aktualności zasad agentów — dokument ClickUp (q7wz-44812) niedostępny lub pusty.
value.details: =Dead-man's-switch nie potwierdził, czy agenci niosą aktualne zasady. page_found={{ $json.page_found }}. Sprawdź dostępność ClickUp Docs v3 i poświadczenie.

nodes.name: Hash Rules
nodes.notes: SHA256(hex) of the rules markdown = the current expected hash. Compared against each live agent's embedded provenance hash.

nodes.name: Get Sync Summary
nodes.notes: One-row gate: are all distinct-model agents created at all, and how long since the last successful sync? Catches the never-synced / partially-synced case loudly (otherwise a zero-agent state would make the per-agent reads run on nothing = silent).

parameters.query: select (count(distinct agent_id) filter (where agent_id is not null)) >= count(distinct model_id) as enough, count(distinct agent_id) filter (where agent_id is not null) as synced_agents, count(distinct model_id) as total_agents, coalesce(round((max(extract(epoch from (now()-synced_at)))/3600.0)::numeric,1),99999) as max_hours, coalesce(string_agg(distinct tier_label, ', ') filter (where agent_id is null),'') as unsynced_tiers from agent_routing where active and model_id <> '';

nodes.name: Agents Synced?
nodes.notes: False -> not every tier has a live agent (never created / partial). CRITICAL.

nodes.name: Alert Not Synced
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1): one or more tiers have no live agent.

value.message: Agenci Managed Agents nie są w pełni utworzeni — brak żywego agenta dla części tierów.
value.details: =Tiery bez agenta: {{ $json.unsynced_tiers }}. Zsynchronizowane agenty: {{ $json.synced_agents }}/{{ $json.total_agents }}. Uruchom Sync Agent Definitions (v1).

nodes.name: Get Agent IDs
nodes.notes: One row per distinct live agent (4). Drives the per-agent live read.

parameters.query: select distinct on (agent_id) tier_label, model_id, agent_id, rules_sha256 as recorded_sha, conventions_version, synced_at from agent_routing where active and agent_id is not null order by agent_id;

nodes.name: Get Live Agent
nodes.notes: GET /v1/agents/{id} per agent. The response carries the deployed system, from which Check Drift extracts the provenance hash. Error output (archived/auth/unreachable) -> CRITICAL. main[1] is the error branch.

nodes.name: Alert Agent Unreadable
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1): a recorded agent could not be read from Anthropic (archived, deleted, or auth failure).

value.message: Nie można odczytać definicji agenta Managed Agents z Anthropic.
value.details: =Agent: {{ $('Get Agent IDs').item.json.tier_label }} ({{ $('Get Agent IDs').item.json.agent_id }}). Błąd: {{ (($json.error||{}).message) || $json.error || JSON.stringify($json).slice(0,300) }}. Agent mógł zostać zarchiwizowany/usunięty lub klucz jest nieważny.

nodes.name: Check Drift
nodes.notes: Per live agent: extract rules_sha256 from the provenance marker in its system and compare to the current CU hash. Missing marker -> CRITICAL (malformed); hash mismatch -> WARN (drift, run sync); content matches but last sync >24h -> WARN (sync writer may be dead). Emits a single verdict {problem, severity, message, details}.

nodes.name: Alert Drift
nodes.notes: Routes the verdict through Post Alert (v1) with the computed severity (WARN drift / CRITICAL malformed). Source managed-agents/rules-freshness.

nodes.name: Fresh
nodes.notes: Terminal for the healthy path. Silent on purpose — a fresh check must not post every 6h.
